messages:
Mia Chen: Quick sync — running a short post-launch groom at 10:00am PT. We have 12 customer reports (6 bugs, 6 enhancement asks). Need to decide hotfix vs follow-on.
Vikram Patel: I can lead triage. Which of the bugs have repros?
Mia Chen: 3 have clear repros, 2 need logs, 1 is flaky (ACME). I'll paste links in a sec.
Olivia Park: Links: https://issues/ACME-203 and https://issues/FOO-88 — added screenshots and minimal repro steps.
Samir Rao: Proposal: any regression -> hotfix (1.1.1). Security/PII -> immediate. UX regressions -> hotfix only if >50% user flow impact.
Dave Kim: From design POV, 3 enhancement asks touch the composer — not trivial. Prefer to scope them to 1.2 unless there's a tiny polish.
Jen Ortega: I'll create milestone "postlaunch-mini" and tag the 12 issues. Also scheduling a 30min groom at 10:30 with eng + design.
Mia Chen: Can we have owners + 1-line acceptance for each issue before the groom? e.g. "repro steps + expected behavior + perf regressed?"
Vikram Patel: I'll assign owners today. For the flaky ACME one I need customer logs — @Mia Chen can you nudge them for logs/steps?
Mia Chen: On it — pinged ACME support thread and asked for session IDs :email:.
triage-bot: auto: 12 issues added to milestone postlaunch-mini; 4 flagged bug-critical.
Olivia Park: Suggestion — batch two low-risk bugs into the same patch to reduce churn and rollback surface.
Samir Rao: +1. If we batch, keep changes small and add feature flags if needed. Hotpatch window target: Fri 9pm PT.
Dave Kim: QA note — batched fixes will need an extra smoke cycle. Can we add 2 QA passes in the timeline?
Jen Ortega: Scheduling QA slots now. Plan: 10:30 groom -> label severity/estimates -> owners assigned -> board link posted.
Mia Chen: Thanks — goal: ship hotfix for critical regressions by EOD Fri, groom remaining enhancements into 1.2 next week. :thumbsup:
